title: No warning for `mssql_where="y > 1"` (raw string, without `text()`) in 1.4

labels.name: alchemy 2
labels.description: goes along with the 2.0 milestone to aid in searching

body:
Further to [this comment](https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/pull/5752#discussion_r538769637) in #5752, no warning is issued for `mssql_where="y > 1"` using the current 1.4 code:

``` python
import sqlalchemy as sa
connection_uri = (
    "mssql+pyodbc://@localhost:49242/mydb?driver=ODBC+Driver+17+for+SQL+Server"
)
engine = sa.create_engine(
    connection_uri,
    future=True,
    echo=True,
)
meta = sa.MetaData()

tbl = sa.Table(
    "gh_sqla_pull_5752",
    meta,
    sa.Column("x", sa.Integer),
    sa.Column("y", sa.Integer),
    sa.Column("z", sa.Integer),
)
idx = sa.Index(
    "foo",
    tbl.c.x,
    mssql_include=[tbl.c.y],
    mssql_where="y > 1",  # no text()
)
tbl.drop(engine, checkfirst=True)
tbl.create(engine)
```
